stage2_patch.explanation: Added an ownership/role guard in AddReply.doPost after reading the client-supplied user parameter and before any database write. The guard retrieves sessionType and sessionUsername from the session and permits access only when the session role is Admin or the session username matches the requested user. Unauthorized cross-user requests are redirected to the forum index and the method returns immediately. This reuses the existing Admin sentinel and sessionUsername ownership pattern from ChangeMessage/DeleteForum while preserving Admin bypass and authorized self-posting.
